title: Letter to the Council of Carthage
english: And they signed. May our Lord keep you for us for very many years, most blessed brother. Likewise signed Alypius, Augustine, Possidius, Marinus, and the rest of the bishops.

Here begin the replies of Cyril, bishop of the Alexandrians, to the synod in Africa, in which he sent through Innocent the presbyter the authentic acts of the council at Nicaea translated from the Greek — which letters, together with the council of Nicaea, were sent through the aforementioned presbyter Innocent and Marcellus the subdeacon of the church at Carthage to the most holy Boniface, bishop of the Roman church, on the sixth day before the kalends
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 77; Ad Carthaginiense concilium (Khazarzar). PD.

title: Greeting and Receipt of the African Letter
english: of December they were sent. To my most honored and most holy lords, brothers and fellow bishops Aurelius and Valentinus, and to the whole most holy synod gathered at Carthage — Cyril, greeting your charity in the Lord.
What your honor wrote, full of deep devotion, I received with all joy through our son Innocent the presbyter.

title: Easter Date and Farewell
english: synod in the city of Nicaea in Bithynia, bound together with this my loving letter — which you will also find by searching in the church history.
But concerning Easter, as you wrote, we announce to you that we shall celebrate it on the seventeenth day before the kalends of May in the coming indiction.
The subscription. May God and our Lord guard your holy synod, as we pray, most honored brothers.
